ai_summary: **Executive Summary: BSE Limited Board Meeting Outcome**  BSE Limited reported robust consolidated financial results for Q1 FY27, demonstrating substantial year-over-year and sequential growth in revenue and net profit, with EPS rising to ₹21.22. A key strategic move includes increasing its direct stake in India International Bullion Holding IFSC Limited (IIBH) from 3.33% to 20% to consolidate ownership and make it a direct associate. No red flags are apparent in this announcement, which also confirmed the appointment of new statutory auditors.
